comparison.objective: Hang a cable between hooks with specified sag; candidate commissions a rigid damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual deformable-shape control and slack allocation versus rigid tool insertion, collar adjustment, counterholding, and tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Both ends hung with 4–6 cm sag and released; no energy absorption or lock-drift criteria.
comparison.reason: Cable-shape control is a materially different tested ability from rigid mechanism tuning.
